verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management/productivity SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows ClickUp offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The pack covers the cloud API, the hosted MCP server, integrations and desktop/mobile apps, none of which constitute self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
